issues: 开场是几乎全黑的空页，蓝图网格淡到看不见，前 1 秒没有可看的东西
页面是占位文案和 6–8px 小字，装完也只是一张读不清的暗色线框页
组件飞入位移小、残影弱，"从画外飞来"的力度不够，看着像淡入
扫描线和页面同一层冷灰蓝，装配完成没有收尾的高光时刻
changes: look 换成 midnight（深蓝 · 电光蓝 · 青），第 1 帧就是完整施工图：120/24px 双层蓝图网格、1640×860 画板虚线外框与尺寸标注、每个组件带「H1 820×250」小标的虚线槽位
页面为镜头重做成虚构天文摄影 App「Umbra」的落地页：120px 两行 H1（渐变强调词）、34px 正文、CTA、程序化银河照片卡（星点 + 银河带 + 山脊剪影）、三项数据
扫描线白芯 + 三层电光蓝辉光，扫过之处页面底色被"刷"出来、网格被照亮；组件在扫描线越过槽位下缘的同一帧落位（提前 14f 起飞，≥4f 间隔）
七个组件从各自方位的画外 260–980px 飞入，±2–7° 起始旋转，EASE.overshoot 过冲贴合，按速度 SpeedBlur 拖影；落位时槽位消失、四角咬合角标从外 20px 咬进
收尾：状态行秒表定格「✓ BUILT · 3.1 s」，蓝图退到 30%，银河卡亮起；全程 1→1.03 极缓推镜，时长 156f
issuesEn: It opened on a near-black empty page with a blueprint grid too faint to see, nothing to look at for the first second
The page was placeholder copy in 6–8px type, so even fully built it was an unreadable dark wireframe
Fly-ins travelled short distances with weak trails, so they read more like fades than pieces arriving from off-frame
Scanline and page shared one cold grey-blue, and the finished build had no closing highlight
changesEn: Midnight look (deep blue, electric blue, cyan); frame 1 is a full construction drawing: a 120/24px two-level blueprint grid, a dashed 1640×860 artboard with a dimension mark, and dashed slots labelled like 'H1 820×250'

The page is rebuilt for camera as a landing page for a fictional astrophotography app, Umbra: a 120px two-line H1 with a gradient accent, 34px body, CTA, a procedural Milky Way photo card (stars, galactic band, ridge silhouette) and three stats

A white-core scanline with three electric-blue glow layers paints the page surface in and lights the grid as it passes; each block lands on the frame the line crosses its slot's bottom edge (takes off 14f early, ≥4f apart)

Seven blocks fly 260–980px in from their own off-frame direction with ±2–7° start rotation, EASE.overshoot snap and velocity-based SpeedBlur; on landing the slot outline vanishes and corner ticks bite in from 20px out
Close: the status timer freezes at '✓ BUILT · 3.1 s', the blueprint drops to 30% and the galaxy card brightens; slow 1→1.03 push throughout, 156f total
